tier.storage_notes: Durable copy of the source data in Amazon S3 Standard (us-east-1 list price, $0.023/GiB-month). The query-ready DuckDB file runs on the instance's included 60 TB local NVMe SSD (single socket / 1 NUMA node), which carries no separate storage charge. compute_price_unit is set to memory_size so the memory ratio is 1.0 and `compute` is the instance's on-demand $/hour.
